title: Exact general roots of unity
objective: Implement a bounded replayable exact roots-of-unity producer for higher-degree totally imaginary number fields, completing cyclotomic quartic class/unit computations without polynomial allowlists

oracles: PARI nfrootsof1 and pinned Hecke torsion_units_gen_order

handoff.summary: Adds a general exact roots-of-unity producer with a universal phi exponent, certified residue-field upper bounds, deterministic generators, bounded embedding-box exhaustion, and authenticated replayable certificates. The proof-authority follow-up removes mutable positive verification caches, makes proof status immutable, adds strict detached JSON reconstruction with full mathematical replay, and declines embedding setup before work when the rigorous 3^degree minimum box exceeds policy. Exact completion covers cyclotomic and translated quartics, including class/unit completion for x^4 + 1, while retaining real-place and imaginary-quadratic behavior.
risks: This lane's old package manifest reports 1,420,179 source bytes against a 1,400,000-byte lazy budget. The integration branch already carries a 1,450,000-byte number-field-global-arithmetic budget; architecture:check must be rerun after cherry-pick.

Exact embedding-box exhaustion is deliberately capped and can return an honest incomplete result for fields whose certified coordinate box exceeds max_candidates; residue-field certification is the normal fast path.

The full native suite passed on the initial exact producer commit before the pure-Python proof-authority follow-up. The integration lane is responsible for the cumulative native receipt and explicitly requested no redundant broad native rerun here.
next_steps: Cherry-pick both roots commits into class-group and rerun pnpm architecture:check under the integration branch's 1,450,000-byte narrow lazy budget.
Record the integration branch's cumulative native validation after the proof-authority follow-up is present.
Use the certificate payload and roots benchmark when profiling higher-degree class/unit completion; do not promote capped fallback results to complete.
